svg.title: Brightdesk Office Suite app centre with one Settings cogwheel
svg.desc: Brightdesk Office Suite App Centre concept with exactly one suite-wide Settings cogwheel in the top-right beside Notifications. The left sidebar contains product navigation only; there is no Settings item in the sidebar and no Settings label or second Settings gear in the left sidebar. The four-panel mark at the top is the Suite logo; each sidebar row has its own original product icon. All ten products are shown for icon reference. Card states are illustrative, not a live account. Install adds a product to the Suite workspace; Update applies to the Suite release. This is concept artwork, not a running application screenshot.
svg.text: Everything you need, all in one place.
Install adds a product to your Brightdesk workspace
It does not download a separate desktop installer. Suite updates are managed separately in Settings.
Install adds an available product to this Brightdesk workspace.
It does not download a separate desktop installer.
Installed products show Open and Uninstall. Removing a product
from the workspace does not delete its local documents.
Update applies to the Brightdesk Suite release, not an individual
product card. Check for updates from Settings.
Automatic checking is optional. Downloading and installing an
update are separate actions and always require confirmation.

CONCEPT PREVIEW · Each product has its own icon; the four-panel mark above is the Brightdesk Suite logo. The sidebar shows all ten icons for reference; a live workspace lists only installed products. Card states are examples, not live account data.
